messages.subject: Project Cedar - engagement letter and NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Priya,

Please find attached our engagement letter for Project Cedar and a confidentiality agreement for execution with the target before data-room access. Could you countersign the engagement letter and we'll arrange for Geoffrey Harrowgate to sign the NDA.

Once the NDA is in place we'll get into the data room and begin diligence.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 0820
